Cynthia Erivo finally responded to the backlash over her playing Jesus in Jesus Christ Superstar. In context of the "Bible" Broadway show, she said:
“Hopefully they will come and realize, ‘Oh, it’s a musical — the gayest place on Earth.’”
When news broke that Erivo — a queer actress and activist — would be portraying Jesus on Broadway's Jesus Christ Superstar, many called it blasphemous. Now, her response is making headlines and raising even more questions.
In this episode of LED Live, we break down the controversy, the media spin, and the spiritual implications behind casting choices like this.
